Composition API - Setup Context: destruc.description:
Vue 2.7+ (or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below).
In Vue 2.7 the setup context is `{ attrs, listeners, slots, emit, expose }`.
`listeners` (equivalent to `this.$listeners`) is Vue 2 only — Vue 3 folds listeners into `attrs`.

Composition API - Setup Context: emit().description:
Vue 2.7+ (or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below).
Emits an event from the component. Equivalent to `this.$emit`.
`setup(props, { attrs, listeners, slots, emit, expose })`

Composition API - Setup Context: expose(.description:
Vue 2.7+ (or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below).
Restricts what a parent can reach through a template ref. Inside `<script setup>` use the `defineExpose()` macro instead.
`setup(props, { attrs, listeners, slots, emit, expose })`

Composition API - Setup Context: listene.description:
Vue 2.7+ only. Equivalent of `this.$listeners`; no Vue 3 counterpart — Vue 3 merges listeners into `attrs` as `onXxx` props.
`setup(props, { attrs, listeners, slots, emit, expose })`
